paper_title: First results of axion dark matter search with DANCE
notes: First results of DANCE Act-1 optical bow-tie cavity polarization search (24-hour observation, no magnetic field). Paper quotes 95% CL upper limit g_agamma <~ 8e-4 GeV^-1 over 1e-14 eV < m_a < 1e-13 eV; encoded as approximately flat two-point bound over the stated validity range. Full mass-dependent exclusion curve is only in Fig. 6 (not extractable as numbers from text).
